newsitem.title: USA: U.S. COFFEE ROASTINGS RISE IN LATEST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: U.S. COFFEE ROASTINGS RISE IN LATEST WEEK.

text.p: Complete Coffee Coverage reported U.S. green coffee roastings as follows:
For the week ended August 2, roastings totaled approximately 365,000 60-kg bags, up from 315,000 bags the previous week and compared with 340,000 bags in the corresponding week one year ago.
Cumulative roastings totaled 9,930,000 60-kg bags, versus 9,825,000 bags in the same year ago period. ((New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
